newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine June inflation 0.1 pct vs 0.8 pct May.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine June inflation 0.1 pct vs 0.8 pct May.

text.p: Ukraine's monthly inflation in June was 0.1 percent against 0.8 percent in May, Economy Minister Yuri Yekhanurov said on Friday.
"The June inflation rate was 0.1 percent," Yekhanurov told reporters, adding Ukraine's annual inflation could be less than 10 percent in 1997.
Early forecasts put 1997 inflation at about 25 percent, compared to 39.7 percent in 1996.
"Inflation so far this year is 5.3 percent, much lower than what we had originally forecast. Ukraine has every possibility of bringing inflation to under 10 percent in 1997," he said.

Serhiy Tyhypko, deputy prime minister in charge of reforms, said this week Ukraine was a "world leader" in slowing inflation. In 1993, two years after independence from the Soviet Union, inflation levels reached 10,000 percent.
